item.title: Apple Watch Series 12: S11 Chip, AI Siri & Live Rewind
item.description: Apple unveils the Watch Series 12 with the new S11 processor, AI‑powered Siri features like Live Rewind and ambient listening, starting at $399.

item.title: iOS 27 Arrives Sep 14: Siri AI Upgrade & UI Tweaks
item.description: Apple releases iOS 27 on September 14, debuting the Siri AI beta, a Liquid Glass opacity slider, refreshed app icons, and extra‑large widgets.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max: AI Camera, A20 Pro & Siri AI
item.description: Apple’s fall “Surprise and Shine” event reveals the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, featuring a 48‑MP variable‑aperture camera, A20 Pro chip, vapor‑chamber cooling, and Siri AI on iOS 27.

item.title: Apple Settles Siri AI Delay Lawsuit for $250M
item.description: Apple gains preliminary court approval for a $250 million settlement, offering up to $95 per eligible iPhone owner after the delayed Siri AI launch.

item.title: Apple Mail’s Siri‑AI Formatting Bar in macOS 27 Beta
item.description: Apple is testing a Siri‑AI powered formatting bar in the Mail compose window of macOS 27 Golden Gate, reshaping email drafting with AI writing tools.

item.title: iOS 27 Public Beta Released
item.description: Apple's latest iOS 27 public beta release brings new features and improvements

item.title: Apple Omitted TV & HomePod
item.description: Apple left Apple TV and HomePod out of WWDC, raising questions about Siri AI plans

item.title: Vision OS 27 Beta Unveiled: Siri AI, Spatial Worlds, and Curved Realities
item.description: Apple's Vision OS 27 beta introduces Siri AI, immersive spatial environments, and redesigned UI elements. Developers can test the update via Settings. This preview highlights key features shaping Apple's spatial computing future.

item.title: iPadOS 27: Siri AI and System Enhancements
item.description: Explore iPadOS 27's Siri AI upgrades, system optimizations, and how they impact power users and workflows.
